raw_response:
I farm only 6 mu, so I cannot gamble too much. For me, the safest way is still wheat and maize in rotation, same as before. I have done this for many years, and around here in Quzhou everybody knows wheat has to be established well in October, then after wheat harvest the maize must go in quickly, otherwise you lose days and yield. I have well water, but pumping costs money, and some people in my family work off-farm, so I cannot manage the field in a very complicated way. My thinking is simple: keep the land fully in wheat-maize, use a moderate fertilizer rate, not the highest, but not too low either. If I save too much on fertilizer and the crop turns yellow, that loss is bigger than the money saved. Wheat I will irrigate more carefully because it responds strongly here. Maize I will watch the rain first, then decide whether to pump. Seed I will buy from the local dealer, the same kind or similar to what has done well in nearby fields. I do not want fancy changes at my age. I want a steady harvest and not too much cash pressure.
